note: Reference points only. No qualifying minimum is chosen here; the owner sets them after reviewing the curves.

pass_cpoe.label: Completion % over expected
pass_cpoe.formula: mean(cpoe) over dropbacks that are pass attempts with a cpoe value

int_rate.label: Interception rate
int_rate.formula: interceptions / pass attempts (sacks and scrambles excluded)

tfl_ps.label: Tackles for loss per 100 defensive snaps

not_measured.reason: Routes run per player are not in the nflverse data. load_participation() has a single `route` value per play (the targeted receiver's route, recorded from 2023 only), not the routes of every receiver on the play, so routes run cannot be counted. Receiving is therefore measured by targets.
